title: Kleya Marki
description: Kleya Marki was the concierge of Luthen Rael's Galactic Antiquities and Objects of Interest. However, Marki was also a highly-skilled spy and master of disguise. A dedicated member of the growing Rebel Alliance, Marki undertook any manner of jobs for Rael and the Alliance. She also acted as a go-between when Rael and others.
